import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# Step 1: classify size
small_mask = df['size'] <= 10

df['biomass_small'] = np.where(small_mask, df['biomass'], 0)
df['biomass_large'] = np.where(~small_mask, df['biomass'], 0)
df['prod_small']    = np.where(small_mask, df['prod'],    0)
df['prod_large']    = np.where(~small_mask, df['prod'],    0)

# Step 2: aggregate sums per transect
agg = df.groupby(['id_reef','year','transect'], as_index=False).agg(
    biomass_small=('biomass_small','sum'),
    biomass_large=('biomass_large','sum'),
    prod_small=('prod_small','sum'),
    prod_large=('prod_large','sum')
)

# Step 3: compute shares
agg['share_biomass_small'] = agg['biomass_small'] / (agg['biomass_small'] + agg['biomass_large']).replace(0, np.nan)
agg['share_prod_small']    = agg['prod_small']    / (agg['prod_small']    + agg['prod_large']).replace(0, np.nan)
agg['delta_share']         = agg['share_prod_small'] - agg['share_biomass_small']

# Deliverable 1: show first 5 transect share values
print("Aggregated transect-based shares (first 5 transects):")
print(agg[['id_reef','year','transect','share_prod_small','share_biomass_small','delta_share']].head(), "\n")

# Step 5: paired t-test on Δshare > 0
delta = agg['delta_share'].dropna()
t_res = stats.ttest_1samp(delta, popmean=0, nan_policy='omit')
t_stat, p_two = t_res.statistic, t_res.pvalue
# one-sided p-value
p_one = (p_two / 2) if t_stat > 0 else (1 - p_two / 2)

print("Paired t-test for mean Δshare > 0:")
print(f" t-statistic = {t_stat:.3f}, one-sided p-value = {p_one:.4f}")
print(f" Mean Δshare = {delta.mean():.4f}, SD = {delta.std():.4f}\n")

# Step 6: density plot of Δshare
plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
plt.hist(delta, bins=50, density=True, alpha=0.6, color='skyblue', edgecolor='gray')
density = stats.gaussian_kde(delta)
xs = np.linspace(delta.min(), delta.max(), 200)
plt.plot(xs, density(xs), color='darkblue')
plt.axvline(0, color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=1)
plt.title('Density of Δshare (share_prod_small - share_biomass_small)')
plt.xlabel('Δshare')
plt.ylabel('Density')
plt.show()

# Optional: mean Δshare by depth
transect_depth = df[['id_reef','year','transect','depth']].drop_duplicates()
strat = transect_depth.merge(agg[['id_reef','year','transect','delta_share']], on=['id_reef','year','transect'])
print("Mean Δshare by depth:")
print(strat.groupby('depth')['delta_share'].mean().to_frame())

import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# Step 1: classify size
df['size_class'] = np.where(df['size'] <= 10, 'small', 'large')

# Step 2: aggregate per transect (id_reef, year, transect)
grp = df.groupby(['id_reef', 'year', 'transect'])
agg = grp.agg(
    biomass_small=('biomass', lambda x: x[df.loc[x.index, 'size_class']=='small'].sum()),
    biomass_large=('biomass', lambda x: x[df.loc[x.index, 'size_class']=='large'].sum()),
    prod_small=('prod',     lambda x: x[df.loc[x.index, 'size_class']=='small'].sum()),
    prod_large=('prod',     lambda x: x[df.loc[x.index, 'size_class']=='large'].sum())
).reset_index()

# Step 3: compute shares
def compute_share(small, large):
    total = small + large
    return small / total.replace(0, np.nan)

agg['share_biomass_small'] = compute_share(agg['biomass_small'], agg['biomass_large'])
agg['share_prod_small']    = compute_share(agg['prod_small'],    agg['prod_large'])
agg['delta_share']         = agg['share_prod_small'] - agg['share_biomass_small']

# Deliverable 1: table of shares (show first rows)
print(f"Aggregated transect-based shares (n={len(agg)} transects):")
print(agg[['id_reef','year','transect','share_prod_small','share_biomass_small','delta_share']].head(), "\n")

# Step 5: paired t-test across transects H1: mean Δshare > 0
delta = agg['delta_share'].dropna()

print(f"Mean Δshare = {delta.mean():.4f}, SD = {delta.std():.4f}\n")
